references.text: Describes the same southern border at Scorpion Ascent (Maaleh-Akrabbim), which is part of Israel's territory.
Mentions Kadesh-Barnea as an important geographical point in the Wilderness of Zin, the same place mentioned in Joshua 15:3.
Refers to Kadesh-Barnea as a place the Israelites reached during their journey, the same geographical reference point.
Mentions Kadesh-Barnea in connection with the sending of the spies, the same place as a boundary marker.
The introduction to the description of the border of the tribe of Judah, which continues in verse 3 with the specific places.
Describes the southern border from the Wilderness of Zin along Edom, the same border area as in Joshua 15:3.
Mentions Kadesh and the southern border in Ezekiel's vision of the future borders of the land.
